name: Femoral Neck Fracture
definition: Intracapsular fracture of the proximal femur, commonly a fragility fracture in older adults and associated with substantial morbidity and mortality.

typical: Shortened externally rotated limb in displaced fractures
Occult fracture may allow partial weight bearing

redFlags.item: Any suspected hip fracture requires urgent assessment

investigations.MRI: MRI is preferred for suspected occult fracture when radiographs are negative; CT may be used when MRI unavailable.
investigations.radiographs: AP pelvis and lateral hip radiographs are first-line.

green: Multidisciplinary analgesia, delirium, thrombosis and rehabilitation care
amber: Displaced fractures and patient factors determine fixation versus arthroplasty; avoid delaying surgery without medical reason.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Bhagna management principles may complement recovery only after modern fracture stabilization and surgical decision-making.

patientEducation.summary: Intracapsular fracture of the proximal femur, commonly a fragility fracture in older adults and associated with substantial morbidity and mortality.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
